description: This file contains utility functions for handling HTTP requests, rendering errors, and OAuth-related UI responses within the Mattermost server, specifically in the channels/utils package.

methods.name: CheckOrigin
methods.description: Checks if the request's Origin header is within the allowed origins.

methods.name: OriginChecker
methods.description: Returns a function that checks if a request's origin is allowed.

methods.name: CheckEmbeddedCookie
methods.description: Checks if the 'MMEMBED' cookie is set to '1', indicating embedded mode.

methods.name: RenderWebAppError
methods.description: Renders an error page for web applications with a given error.

methods.name: RenderWebError
methods.description: Renders an HTML error page or redirects based on status, signing the URL.

methods.name: RenderMobileAuthComplete
methods.description: Displays a mobile OAuth completion message with redirect.

methods.name: RenderMobileError
methods.description: Displays an error message in mobile UI with fallback URL.

methods.name: RenderMobileMessage
methods.description: Outputs a simple HTML page with a message for mobile clients.
